(def ^{:doc "Returns a laziness-preserving sequence of all but the first n items in coll.
  Returns a stateful transducer when no collection is provided." :arglists '([n] [n coll])} drop
  (fn ([n]
   (when-not (number? n) (throw (suss.bootstrap/error "Assert failed: (number? n)")))
     (fn [rf]
       (let [na (atom n)]
         (fn
           ([] (rf))
           ([result] (rf result))
           ([result input]
              (let [n @na]
                (swap! na dec)
                (if (pos? n)
                  result
                  (rf result input))))))))
  ([n coll]
   (when-not (number? n) (throw (suss.bootstrap/error "Assert failed: (number? n)")))
     (if (implements? IDrop coll)
       (or
         (if (pos? n)
           (-drop coll (suss.bootstrap/f64-ceil n))
           (seq coll))
         ())
       (let [step (fn [n coll]
                    (let [s (seq coll)]
                      (if (and (pos? n) s)
                        (recur (dec n) (rest s))
                        s)))]
         (new LazySeq nil (fn* [] (step n coll)) nil nil))))))
